sujet: Une sortie coûte vite trop cher

scenes.prompt: A worried but amused French mother and father sit at a cozy kitchen table counting a few coins next to an open empty piggy bank and a calculator, while three excited children aged 7 to 10 in coats and scarves wait by the door, ready to go out.

Inside a cozy French home: a surprised father holds a very long blank paper receipt that unrolls all the way to the floor, a mother raises her eyebrows with a smile, three children aged 7 to 10 hold balloons and plush toys, a cat plays with the end of the receipt.

Three children aged 7 to 10 dressed as little knights with cardboard armor, golden paper crowns and a helmet with a red plume, unrolling an old treasure map in a sunny cobbled lane of an Alsatian village lined with colorful half-timbered houses and flower boxes full of red geraniums, one holding a big magnifying glass.

A big joyful group of six children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights with crowns and a red plumed helmet run together through a flowery cobbled street of an Alsatian town with half-timbered houses, following clues, smiling parents walking behind them.
